uzo.purpose: Tells the person in the flow of the page what happened or what to watch for: saved, could not save, import not confirmed. Closed, it hides itself and stays in the document; the application removes it on dismiss if it wants.

instead.kialo: A notice asks nothing, because it reads in the flow of the page; what needs a decision interrupts, and that is a dialogo.
One to three words next to a title are a badge, because a status is read at a glance; a notice is a sentence.
An error of one field stands at the field, because the person corrects it there (slot error of the kampo); a notice names what no field owns.
Content about one thing is a card, because it stays as long as the thing does; a notice tells what happened.

boundary.kialo: A notice that goes away by itself is missed by whoever reads slowly, zooms in or has the focus elsewhere, because it is gone before they get there (WCAG 2.2.1, 4.1.3); a message stays in the flow of the page as an avizo until it is closed.
Several notices at once compete for the same attention, because each claims the flow of the page; a person decides which stay and in which order.

containers.name: page
containers.kialo: A notice belongs to the page whose state it tells, because that is where the person reads on.

containers.name: dialog
containers.kialo: A notice stands at the top of a dialog's content when a confirmation failed, because the person decides there what to do next.

with.kialo: A notice may offer the next step as an action, because what to do about it is one button: at most one with emphasis high.
A notice may lead to where the matter is, because a destination is a link, not an action.
The icon of the intent stands before the words as an ikono, because a sign is read faster than a word; never alone — the intent word is heard, the colour is the status text's (G6).
A heading over the message is a text of the notice, no level of the page; where a page section needs a heading, that is a titolo.

case.de: Die Person muss etwas entscheiden, bevor es weitergeht.
case.en: The person has to decide something before anything goes on.

case.de: Ein Zustand passt in ein bis drei Wörter neben einem Titel.
case.en: A state fits into one to three words beside a title.

case.de: Der Fehler gehört zu einem einzelnen Feld und wird dort berichtigt.
case.en: The error belongs to a single field and is corrected there.

case.de: Es geht um Inhalt über ein Ding, der so lange bleibt wie das Ding.
case.en: It is content about one thing that stays as long as the thing does.

do.de: Wähle intent nach dem, was geschah: info, success, warning oder danger für einen Fehler.
do.en: Choose intent by what happened: info, success, warning, or danger for an error.

do.de: Sag im Text, was die Person jetzt tun kann, vor allem bei einem Fehler.
do.en: Say in the text what the person can do now, above all for an error.

do.de: Setze dismissible, wenn der Hinweis erledigt sein kann; geschlossen bleibt er verborgen.
do.en: Set dismissible when the notice can be done with; closed, it stays hidden.

dont.de: Einen Hinweis von selbst verschwinden lassen, denn wer langsam liest oder vergrößert, verpasst ihn.
dont.en: Let a notice disappear by itself, because whoever reads slowly or zooms in misses it.

dont.de: Mehrere Hinweise auf einmal stapeln, die um dieselbe Aufmerksamkeit streiten.
dont.en: Stack several notices at once that compete for the same attention.

dont.de: Für eine bloße Auskunft intent warning oder danger nehmen, denn beide werden sofort als Alarm vorgelesen.
dont.en: Use intent warning or danger for mere information, because both are read out at once as an alert.

none.de: Der Hinweis selbst nimmt keine Taste; ist er schließbar, ist sein Knopf zum Schließen eine gewöhnliche Schaltfläche für Enter und Leertaste.
none.en: The notice itself takes no key; when it can be closed, its close button is an ordinary button for Enter and Space.
